name: Physics Weather Agent
description: Applies atmospheric physics equations and numerical weather simulation to compute precipitation, temperature, wind, and barometric trends.
methodology: Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) & Thermodynamic Atmospheric Fluid Modeling

name: Cloud / Satellite Agent
description: Performs radar and geostationary infrared satellite imagery nowcasting to track cloud-top cooling and short-term convective precipitation bands.
methodology: Satellite Infrared Cloud Movement & Radar Vertically Integrated Liquid (VIL) Nowcasting

name: Historical Weather / ML Agent
description: Analyzes multi-decade historical weather analogues and empirical meteorological archives to identify recurrence probabilities and seasonal baselines.
methodology: Historical Climatological Analogue Matching & Data-Driven Machine Learning Forecasting

name: Historical Market Agent
description: Studies historical equity price action, trading volumes, maximum historical drawdowns, and annualized price volatility regimes.
methodology: Technical Momentum, Moving Average Regimes & Historical Volatility Profiling

name: Fundamental Analysis Agent
description: Performs forensic analysis of corporate SEC 10-K filings, verifying operating cash flows, revenue margins, debt-to-equity, and balance sheet solvency.
methodology: Fundamental Ratio Deconstruction & Liquidity / Solvency Assessment

name: Economic Agent
description: Integrates macroeconomic datasets including central bank policy rates, CPI inflation, GDP forecasts, and bond spreads to gauge systemic headwinds.
methodology: Macroeconomic Regime Modeling & Monetary Transmission Analysis

name: Financial Risk Agent
description: Adversarial financial specialist that actively challenges bullish assumptions by auditing debt surges, multiple expansion, and cash flow degradation.
methodology: Adversarial Stress Testing & Vulnerability / Downside Auditing

name: Infrastructure Agent
description: Compares proposed bridge and civil works parameters against the FHWA National Bridge Inventory (NBI) to evaluate structural archetypes and pier stability.
methodology: Empirical Bridge Inventory Benchmarking & Structural Feasibility Profiling

name: Construction Cost Agent
description: Estimates capital expenditure requirements using FHWA Bridge Replacement Unit Cost databases, applying deck area formulas and regional cost adaptations.
methodology: Parametric Unit-Cost Square-Meter Synthesis & Contingency Budgeting

name: Environmental / Water Agent
description: Audits river flow rates, 100-year flood lines, aquatic migration pathways, and statutory conservation buffers using USGS National Hydrography data.
methodology: Hydrological Streamflow Modeling & Riparian Conservation Impact Auditing

name: Terrain / Geospatial Agent
description: Extracts digital elevation models (DEM) and slope profiles from USGS 3DEP to determine earthwork cut-and-fill feasibility and approach gradients.
methodology: Digital Elevation Model (DEM) Topographic & Slope Angle Synthesis

name: Earth Observation Agent
description: Leverages NASA Earthdata multispectral satellite observations to calculate vegetation vigor (NDVI), canopy cover, and surface moisture variations.
methodology: Multispectral Satellite Remote Sensing & NDVI Index Quantification

name: Solar / Energy Agent
description: Simulates photovoltaic energy capture based on NREL NSRDB solar radiation datasets, computing GHI, DNI, and seasonal monsoon derating.
methodology: Solar Irradiance Resource Modeling (GHI/DNI) & Specific Energy Yield Simulation

name: Electricity / Grid Agent
description: Reviews US EIA regional electricity statistics, substation headroom, transmission voltages, and grid interconnection economics.
methodology: Transmission Headroom Feasibility & Wholesale Energy Economic Analysis

name: Agriculture Agent
description: Combines FAOSTAT crop production data, USDA NASS yield curves, and agro-climatic requirements to identify resilient, high-suitability cultivars.
methodology: Agro-Ecological Soil Water Budgeting & Cultivar Suitability Ranking

name: Traffic Prediction Agent
description: Leverages Caltrans PeMS and METR-LA inductive loop road sensors to model spatiotemporal traffic velocity and peak morning congestion bottlenecks.
methodology: Spatiotemporal Sensor Flow Dynamics & Volume-Capacity Bottleneck Modeling

name: Cross-Domain Risk Agent
description: Adversarial cross-examination specialist. Consumes outputs across civil, environmental, financial, and physical domains to detect contradictions and tail risks.
methodology: Adversarial Multi-Disciplinary Cross-Examination & Systemic Risk Auditing

name: Agent Router
description: Deconstructs natural language user queries, determines the required domain expertise, and dynamically recruits specialist agents based on reputation.
methodology: Intent & Expertise Taxonomy Deconstruction & Dynamic Multi-Agent Routing
